notes: A first-person sci-fi FPS against alien enemies is Shooter outright, and nothing else in the prompt is a second genre. open-battlefield is the genre's shape for one contiguous map with dispersed points of interest rather than defined lanes, which is what the author's one medium arena with cover and room to run around is; lane-network was rejected because there are no teams and no parallel fronts to channel. PvE Shooter was the nearest preset, but I swapped its shape and dropped both choke-bottleneck and building-interior — nothing pinches, and the author asked for one focused arena rather than buildings to go inside, which also keeps this off P3 — so per the skill it is built from scratch rather than carrying a preset name it no longer resembles. With no user to ask, I followed the answer that a fixed roster of aliens is cleared rather than endless waves, so the enemy origins are placed positions and the run ends when the map is cleared; hiding behind objects is what earns cover-los.
